Images 2/3 are style references ONLY for dark rich forest green painted finish and the italic white/green Full Muscle Equipment logo. Image 4 is the opposite-angle TZ color-zone guide with red levers. Image 5 is the completed Full Muscle opposite-angle view of THIS SAME MACHINE and establishes exact color/logo consistency. On target image 1 this angled bar lies in front of the stack, slopes down left from under the seat handle to the shin roller, and is seen mainly from the rear. Opaque white background, original target viewpoint and crop, exact engineering geometry. Keep instruction text Leg Extension and small diagrams. No collage, new parts, captions, shape changes. Deliver one edited image matching image 1.
